subject: Post-demo: inference cost & trial credit plan — BlueWave Analytics
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluewave.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tasha Lee <tasha@bluewave.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — cost profile & next steps

Thanks again for a really helpful walkthrough today. Quick recap from our side and a few questions so we can align with finance: 

- Typical usage: baseline ~1M tokens/day, spikes up to 5M tokens/day during peak campaigns.
- Expected monthly run-rate for this pilot (30 days): roughly 60–120M tokens depending on ramp.
- Targeted unit economics for us: looking to land at or under $50 per 1M tokens for production; for pilot we can tolerate up to $90/1M but need clarity on how that maps to model choice/quantization.
- Constraints: budget band for Q3 pilot is $10k–$20k total; any trial credits or extensions will materially affect our ability to finish evaluation.

A couple of asks: 
1) Can you provide a short table mapping model variant → expected $/1M tokens (approx) and latency SLOs for our 1k–3k token prompts?
2) Would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of trial credits (we burned faster than expected in initial tests)? If so, what size is typical and what guardrails do you need?
3) We also need a simple SOW or statement of work to share with procurement—can you draft a light one that we can review?

If useful, I attached the rough traffic forecast (high/medium/low) — happy to jump on a quick follow-up tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Samir
Director of Product, BlueWave Analytics

Attachments: forecast_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — cost profile & trial credit plan

Samir — thanks for the clear summary and helpful numbers. Recap + proposed next steps below so we're all aligned.

Recap of what we heard from you:
- Pilot expected monthly consumption band: 60–120M tokens.
- Baseline 1M/day, spikes to 5M/day.
- Budget range for pilot: $10k–$20k. Target $/1M tokens preference: ideally <= $50 for production.

Quick answers / asks from our side:
- Unit-econ mapping: I'll attach a short sheet that estimates approximate $/1M tokens at our recommended model tiers (gptx-std-q4, gptx-med-q4, gptx-quant). These are estimates and vary by sequence length and batching. See attachment: usage_projections.xlsx.
- Trial credits: we can provision an additional one-time credit to help you complete the evaluation. I need approval from Finance on the exact amount — asking Marcus to weigh in below.
- SOW: attaching a lightweight SOW template (SOW-draft.pdf) that covers the pilot scope, timelines, and acceptance criteria. If that looks good we can convert to DocuSign.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Marcus to confirm trial credit top-up and guardrails (spend cap / monitoring cadence).
2) BlueWave confirms which model tier to test first (we recommend starting with gptx-med-q4 for cost/latency balance).
3) If agreeable, sign the lightweight SOW and we’ll enable the credit and a shared Slack channel for dev support.

Timing: if you confirm model tier and accept SOW by EOD Wed (PDT), we can enable credits and schedule a kickoff call Thurs/Fri.

Thanks — looping Marcus and Rachel to finalize the credit and SOW.

—Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: usage_projections.xlsx (spreadsheet); SOW-draft.pdf (light template)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — credit top-up and monitoring cadence

Hi team — quick note from Finance/RevOps. I've approved a one-time trial credit top-up of $12,000 for BlueWave Analytics under deal BW-2026-78. A few guardrails and operational items: 

- Credit limits: $12,000 applied to the pilot account, available for 30 days from enablement. Any consumption beyond the credit will be billed at standard trial overage rates unless we agree an interim invoice.
- Monitoring: we want a weekly burn check-in (10–15 minutes) for the first month. Olga, please schedule recurring Fri 9:00am PDT checks; Samir, confirm if that works.
- Acceptance milestone: if BlueWave reaches a stable 1M tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days and is satisfied with latency, we’ll fast-track Dedicated pricing conversation (we can present $/1M tiers and a commit-based discount).
- SOW: I reviewed the draft; minor edits on sections 2.1 and 3.2. Olga, please send the updated SOW and DocuSign link.

Operational note: to avoid surprise consumption we’ll enable an alert at 60% of the credit and another at 90%. Please ensure your engineering lead has read-only access to the Console so they can watch token consumption in real time.

Marcus
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SOW-draft.pdf (updated edits)
Related link: https://app.redwood.ai/hubspot/5401234
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluewave.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tasha Lee <tasha@bluewave.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — acknowledgement

Thanks — we appreciate the quick turnaround and the $12k credit. That cadence works for us (Fri 9am PDT).

Next: I’ll confirm which model tier to test (leaning gptx-med-q4) by EOD today and we’ll review the SOW this afternoon. Can you send proposed kickoff slots for Thurs/Fri so our eng lead can join?

Best,
Samir
